design: One source-selection call per original v4 source. Same source events, original rubrics, model digest and generation settings. New prompt/schema/representation; not an isolated prompt-only comparison. No draft outputs are given to the selector.
acceptance: Review all46 outcomes for correct retention, complete scope/conditions/referents, authority, independent source coverage and original ambiguity notes. Exact slices do not establish correct selection. Preserve errors and regressions without selective retries or adoption.
limits: Unblinded reused development cases, one stochastic repetition. Punctuation/line units are not a linguistic parser. Contiguous extraction can retain irrelevant neighboring material or omit context. No fresh holdout, target reconciliation, durable write, full-module or host acceptance.
